name: print-social-blue-theatre-seats-limited-spaces-webinar-flyer
title: Limited Spaces Webinar over Blue Theatre Seats
whatItIs: A dark flyer over a photo of glowing blue theatre seats with a green label 'LIMITED' above huge white 'SPACES' with a hand-drawn underline, logo and 'Free live webinar' at the top, a short paragraph and an outlined 'Register now' oval.
whatItMeans: Rows of seats literalise the scarcity message, and the one lit seat draws the eye.
techniques: Photo that literally illustrates the message
Green label sticker over heavy white type
Dark vignette to focus the centre

vocabulary.definition: Copy stressing limited availability to prompt action.
A coloured tag placed over a headline.
A call to action drawn as an outline.
